finance.noAccess.title: You can't view finance
finance.noAccess.description: Ask an owner or admin of this organization for access.
finance.policies.title: Policies & budgets
finance.policies.description: Set what your agents may spend, per token, and who must approve larger payments.
finance.policies.cooperative: Agents check these policies with 4mica before they pay. 4mica isn't in the payment path, so it can't stop a payment by itself: anything spent without a check is flagged when the seller reports the payment, and still counts toward your limits.
finance.policies.emptyDescription: Add a policy to give your agents budgets, per-payment caps and approval rules.
finance.policy.formLead: Agents check this policy before paying. Payments made without a check are flagged once reported.
finance.policy.fields.name: Name
finance.policy.modeHint.ENFORCE: Agents that check are told to stop when a limit would be broken.
finance.policy.modeHint.MONITOR: Nothing is refused. You only get alerts as spending reaches your thresholds.
finance.policy.fields.tokenHint: Amount limits are in this token. Without one, only freezing and the recipient list apply.
finance.policy.fields.approvalsRequiredH: How many people must approve a payment above the threshold.
finance.policy.fields.recipientsHint: One address per line. Leave empty to allow any recipient.
finance.policy.fields.alertsHint: Percentages of the daily and monthly limits, separated by commas.
finance.policy.errors.name: Give the policy a name.
finance.policy.errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
finance.policy.errors.tokenRequired: Limits need a token. Choose the token they're in.
finance.policy.errors.approvals: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
finance.policy.errors.thresholds: Use up to {{max}} whole percentages from 1 to 100.
finance.policy.freezeBody: Takes effect immediately: agents that check before paying are told not to spend under this policy.
finance.policy.unfreezeBody: Agents can spend under this policy again. This may need approval first.
finance.policy.deleteBody: Its limits stop applying. This may need approval first.
finance.approvals.title: Approvals
finance.approvals.description: Payments and governed changes waiting for a second person. Pending requests come first.
finance.approvals.emptyDescription: Requests that need approval will show up here.
finance.approvals.twoPersonRule: You asked for this, so you can't approve it yourself. Someone else with approval rights has to decide it — that's the two-person rule.
finance.approvals.applyLead: This change is approved. Apply it to make it take effect.
finance.approvals.applyMissing: This change is approved, but it was requested from another browser. Apply it from there.
finance.alerts.title: Alerts
finance.alerts.description: Budgets nearing their limits, refused checks, and payments sellers reported that no spend check covered.
finance.authorizations.title: Spend checks
finance.authorizations.description: Every time an agent asked 4mica before paying, and what it was told.
finance.authorizations.emptyDescription: They appear when agents using the SDK check a payment before signing it.
finance.reports.title: Reports
finance.reports.description: Spending and income per token for the networks of the current environment, with exports for your books.
finance.reports.authorizedNotReportedHin: Spend checks an agent used, with no payment reported by a seller yet.
finance.reports.reportedNotAuthorizedHin: Payments from your wallets that sellers reported, made without asking 4mica first.
governance.title: Governance
governance.description: Decide which changes need a second person, who hears about spending, and how long the audit log is kept.
governance.readOnly: Only owners can change these settings.
governance.personal.title: Personal workspaces have no governance
governance.personal.description: Create an organization to require approvals from teammates.
governance.approvals.title: Approvals
governance.approvals.description: Sensitive changes wait until someone other than the requester approves them.
governance.fields.approvalsRequiredHint: Set to off to apply changes straight away.
governance.action.spending_policy.change: Creating, editing, deleting or unfreezing a policy. Freezing always takes effect immediately.
governance.action.api_key.create_product: Creating or rotating any API key in production, including resource and service account keys.
governance.action.wallet.remove.title: Removing wallets
governance.action.wallet.remove.descript: Removing one or more linked wallets.
governance.action.member.role_grant.desc: Making someone an Owner, Admin or Finance member, by role change or invitation, and transferring ownership.
governance.errors.ttl: Enter a whole number of hours from 1 to 720.
governance.alerts.title: Finance alerts
governance.alerts.description: Who gets an email about budgets, refused checks and spend without a check.
governance.fields.recipientsHint: Leave empty to email everyone who can manage finance.
governance.audit.title: Audit log
governance.audit.description: How long entries are kept before they are deleted.
governance.fields.retentionHint: From 30 to 3650 days. Leave empty to keep them forever.
governance.errors.retention: Enter a whole number of days from 30 to 3650, or leave it empty.
store.finance.selfApproval: You asked for this change, so someone else has to decide it.
store.finance.approvalClosed: This request has already been decided, cancelled or has expired.
store.finance.approvalInvalid: This approval can no longer be used. It may have expired, been used already, or the change no longer matches what was approved.
store.finance.policySavedBody: Agents that check spending before paying will follow it from now on.
store.finance.frozenBody: Agents that check before paying will be told not to spend under this policy.
store.finance.unfrozenBody: Agents can spend under this policy again, within its limits.
store.finance.applyMissing: This browser doesn't have the original change. Apply it from the browser you requested it in.
store.finance.governanceSavedBody: New requests follow these rules from now on.
